text: あなたも　おはか　まいりに　きたの？

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に before a verb of coming or going shows what you come or go to do. まいりに　きた = 'came to pay a visit'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice makes a soft, friendly question. きたの？ = 'did you come?'
